label: Identity
description: An epistery digital identity — an IdentityContract on chain: a collection of interchangeable device keys (rivets), any of which can act for it. Epistery-published vocabulary; the contract state is re-readable by anyone, scan's copy is a cache of it.

trust.note: Reserved — identity trust factors (rivet count and age, delegate status, domain binding) declared here as the market defines them. The contract itself is the primary fact.
